description: Synthesis core and post-process integration (design 4.1-4.4, 5.2, 6.4, 7.1 synthesis tests; OD1 cortical deviation; OD5/OD6). `SynthConfig` + constants in data_loading/params.py; new data_loading/synth.py (hierarchical group contrast with per-image jitter, separable Gaussian blur, re-mask, bias field, robust p99.5 normalisation, gamma, noise; fixed draw pattern from a third generator; `tf.cond` switch; CPU-device fallback); LinearPostprocess / DeformPostprocess gain `synth=None` and KEYWORD-ONLY `labels=` / `synth_override=` (linear renders the template-space synthetic image with T_mm^-1; deform maps fine ids to train18 with a 256-entry gather). Default off builds nothing. Depends on FEAT-001 (preprocessing.luts.synthfine_to_train18_table / synthfine_cortex_ids). The trainer is NOT touched here (FEAT-003).
steps: data_loading/params.py: add `SYNTH_SEED_OFFSET = 104729`, `SYNTH_DEVICES = ("gpu", "cpu")`, `SYNTH_LABEL_SET_DEFAULT = "synthfine"`, the column layout `SYNTH_COLUMNS = {"flag": 0, "blur_family": 1, "blur_base": 2, "remask": 3, "bias_std": 4}` (group uniforms of design 4.4; the log-gamma group normal is drawn separately) with `N_SYNTH_GROUP_UNIFORMS = 5`, and the dataclass `SynthConfig` with the design 4.1 fields and defaults (prob 0.0, jitter 0.08, std_max 0.08, fwhm_mr_mm (0.0, 3.0), fwhm_pet_mm (4.0, 8.0), pet_family_prob 0.5, fwhm_image_jitter 0.10, bias_grid 4, bias_std_max 0.3, gamma_log_std 0.25, noise_std_max 0.03, remask_prob 0.5, hier_dev 0.1, hier_dev_cortex 0.25 (OD1, NEW), norm_quantile 0.995, device 'gpu', label_set 'synthfine'). Docstring per field with the design section. Keep the module TF-free.

data_loading/synth.py (new; imports tensorflow, numpy, data_loading.params, preprocessing.luts only; module docstring = design 4.2-4.4 summary, memory notes of 6.1, OD1 cortex rule): `fine_to_train18_table()` -> tf.constant int32 [256] from `luts.synthfine_to_train18_table()`; `dev_halfwidth_table(cfg)` -> float32 [256] (hier_dev_cortex for `luts.synthfine_cortex_ids()`, hier_dev for other ids, 0 for id 0 and >= 103); `draw_synth_params(generator, n, cfg)` with a FIXED draw pattern independent of p and the flag value: group `uniform([N_SYNTH_GROUP_UNIFORMS])`, one group `normal([1])` (log-gamma), group tables `uniform([3, 256])` (row 0 class means indexed by train18 id, row 1 class stds, row 2 parcel deviations indexed by fine id), per-image `uniform([n, 256])` (jitter), `uniform([n, 3])` (FWHM jitter), `uniform([n, 1])` (noise std), `normal([n, g^3])` (bias grid), `make_seeds(n)` x 2 (stateless normals; transpose like tf_intensity_aug); returns a dict incl. `flag = u_flag < cfg.prob` and the derived mean table `clip(gather(cls_mean, g) + 2 * dev_half * (dev - 0.5), 0, 1)` and std table `gather(std_max * cls_std, g)` with entry 0 of both set to 0 (g = fine_to_train18_table). `synthesize_image(labels_u8, d_i, fwhm_jit_i, noise_u_i, bias_i, seeds_i, prm, cfg, level)` = design 4.2 steps 1-7 (gathers only, no one_hot; blur via three in-graph [n, n] Gaussian operators with rows exp(-(o-j)^2 / (2 sigma^2)) normalised to sum 1 and sigma_vox = sqrt((FWHM/2.3548)^2 + s^2/12)/s, applied with `tf_intensity_aug._apply_axis_matrix`; remask by a group draw; bias = exp(field) with three STATIC numpy-built [n, g] linear-interpolation matrices (same physical spacing at all levels: control points at fixed fractions of the extent); robust normalisation on the stride-4 subsample with `tf.boolean_mask` + `tf.math.top_k` (dynamic k = max(1, round((1 - norm_quantile) * size))) guarded by `tf.cond(size > 0, ..., lambda: 1.0)` and `max(hi, 1e-6)`, then clip [0, 1]; gamma pow; noise; clip; final re-mask). `synthesize_group(labels_u8, prm, cfg, level)` -> float32 [N, X, Y, Z, 1] via `tf.map_fn(..., parallel_iterations=1, fn_output_signature=TensorSpec(shape[1:], float32))` under `tf.name_scope('synth')`. `maybe_synthesize(images, labels_u8, flag, prm, cfg, level, render=None)` = `tf.cond(flag, synth_branch, lambda: images)` where synth_branch = render(synthesize_group(...)) if render else synthesize_group(...); with cfg.device == 'cpu' the true-branch body runs under `tf.device('/cpu:0')`. Explicit float32 everywhere (mixed_float16 policy does not touch raw ops). Python 3.8 syntax.

data_loading/postprocess.py: `_synth_setup(cfg, seed)` -> (None, None) when cfg is None or cfg.prob == 0, else (cfg, tf.random.Generator.from_seed(seed + P.SYNTH_SEED_OFFSET)); both classes get `synth=None` in __init__ (last keyword) and attributes `self.synth`, `self.synth_generator`. `LinearPostprocess.__call__(self, images, t_dali, rt_dali=None, flip_axes=None, *, labels=None, synth_override=None)`: when `self.synth is None` the body is TODAY'S CODE VERBATIM (same op order; do not move dali_to_mm on the off path). When on: labels None -> ValueError('synthesis on: labels= required'); cast; t_mm = dali_to_mm(t_dali, ...) first; prm = draw_synth_params(self.synth_generator, n, cfg) (always drawn, also with an override); flag = prm['flag'] if synth_override is None else tf.constant(bool(synth_override)); render = per-image `models.layers.transform_image(img[None], tfm.affine_inverse(t_mm_i)[None], spacing, interpolation='linear', fill_value=0.0)` in a map_fn with parallel_iterations 1 (pull relation I_i(y) = S_i(T_i^-1 y), check affine_inverse argument conventions in models/transforms.py and transform_image's matrix convention in models/layers.py against the module docstring step 2); images = maybe_synthesize(images, labels, flag, prm, cfg, level, render); then the existing aug, target, flips, targets, pairs; output dict gains 'synth' (bool scalar). `DeformPostprocess.__call__(self, images, labels, t_dali=None, flip_axes=None, *, synth_override=None)`: off -> today's code verbatim; on -> cast, draw, flag, images = maybe_synthesize(images, fine labels, flag, prm, cfg, level) (no render), labels = tf.gather(fine_to_train18_table(), tf.cast(fine, tf.int32)) (squeeze rank 5 as today), then the existing aug, flips, one_hot(labels, 19), pairs; dict gains 'synth'. Update the module and class docstrings (step 0b synthesis).

tests/runtime_helpers.py: add `fine_labels_from_train18(lab, rng)` mapping a train18-class label map (uint8, e.g. `fd.synthetic_label_phantom` labels 1..8 read as train18 classes) to synthfine ids with table[fine] == lab: each class voxel gets a fine id of its class; class 2 (cortex) is split into >= 3 spatially coherent parcels (e.g. by x slabs) and classes with two hemispheric ids split left/right by the x mid-plane; and `write_fake_export(..., fine_labels=False)`: with labels=True and fine_labels=True also writes `labels_synthfine<sfx>.npy` and lists it in `labels_l<k>` ('labels_train18<sfx>.npy;labels_synthfine<sfx>.npy'); default output unchanged byte for byte.

tests/test_synth.py (new, unittest, `from tests import tf_setup` first; level 4, N 4): shapes/dtypes/range/finite; seeded determinism (same seed twice bit-equal); one contrast per group (blur/bias/gamma/noise/jitter/std off via a test cfg: per-label means equal across images; with jitter j ratios within [(1-j)/(1+j), (1+j)/(1-j)]); background 0 with remask forced; normalisation: in-mask p99.5 of the pre-noise image == 1 within subsample tolerance and max <= 1; fine_to_train18_table vs preprocessing.luts for all 103 ids, >= 103 -> 0; OD1: with hier_dev 0.1 / hier_dev_cortex 0.25 the mean table of cortical fine ids deviates from the class mean by up to 0.25 and non-cortical by <= 0.1 (and the cortical deviation exceeds 0.1 for some id over a few draws), dev_halfwidth_table matches synthfine_cortex_ids; OneHot depth multiset on the FULL graph-def (gd.node + every gd.library.function[*].node_def, depth from the Const input) of a traced LinearPostprocess and DeformPostprocess call with synthesis ON equals OFF, also with `--lowres-method tent` intensity aug enabled; negative control: a test-only synthesis variant that one-hots the fine labels (depth 103) inside tf.cond/map_fn makes the comparison fail; trace once on the drawn path (tf.function with input_signature, p 0.5, a fixed seed found once that yields both outcomes within 8 calls: one trace, synth True and False seen); synth_override=False output bit-equal to the synth=None post-process for the same inputs and flip_axes (linear and deform; the deform labels arg given as fine ids must yield the same train18 labels/onehot); render consistency: the synthetic linear image equals transform_image of the unwarped synthetic image with T_mm^-1 and the targets equal the off-path targets; CPU device path equals the default path (values) on CPU-placed inputs; default off: synth=None and SynthConfig(prob=0) create no synth_generator; linear call with synthesis on and no labels raises ValueError. Extend tests/test_postprocess.py: labels / synth_override are keyword-only (positional extra arg -> TypeError), off-path call signatures unchanged.
Run the verification commands and append them + results to .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/impl-log.md.

findings: Iteration 1 done (uncommitted). Files: data_loading/params.py (SynthConfig incl. hier_dev_cortex 0.25, SYNTH_SEED_OFFSET 104729, SYNTH_DEVICES, SYNTH_LABEL_SET_DEFAULT, SYNTH_COLUMNS, N_SYNTH_GROUP_UNIFORMS 5; still TF-free), data_loading/synth.py (new), data_loading/postprocess.py, tests/runtime_helpers.py, tests/test_synth.py (new, 25 tests), tests/test_postprocess.py (+TestSynthCallSignature, 2 tests). For FEAT-003: (1) post-process constructors take `synth=` as the LAST keyword; `_synth_setup` treats None AND prob 0 as off (post.synth / post.synth_generator None), so `Trainer._synth_on` must equal `pp.synth is not None` (or cfg.synth None at p 0, as synth_config_from_args does); (2) linear call `pp(images, T[, Rt], labels=<uint8 [N,X,Y,Z,1] fine ids, template space>, synth_override=<None|bool>)`; deform `pp(images, fine_labels[, t_dali], synth_override=...)` (fine ids positional, mapped to train18 inside); with synthesis off `labels`/`synth_override` are accepted and IGNORED (no error, no op), so _pp_call must not rely on an error there; with synthesis on a linear call without labels raises ValueError('synthesis on: labels= required') at trace time; (3) batch dict gains 'synth' (bool scalar tensor) only when on -> step results / logging; (4) checkpoint entry: `pp.synth_generator` (tf.random.Generator) only when not None; (5) synth_override is converted with tf.constant(bool(...)) -> a Python bool argument (eager recal path), never a tensor. Test helpers: `rh.fine_labels_from_train18(lab [X,Y,Z], rng)` and `rh.write_fake_export(..., labels=True, fine_labels=True)` (writes labels_synthfine<sfx>.npy, labels_l<k> 'labels_train18<sfx>.npy;labels_synthfine<sfx>.npy', own rng seed+1 so images are identical to fine_labels=False; default output unchanged). For FEAT-005 (eval presets): `synth.draw_synth_params(generator, n, cfg)` returns a dict {flag, mean[256], std[256], cls_mean[256], jitter[n,256] (relative d), fwhm_mm[n,3], pet_family, remask (bool), gamma, noise_std[n], bias[n,g^3] (group std applied), seeds[n,2,2]}; a preset can overwrite entries (e.g. mean/std/fwhm_mm/remask) and call `synth.synthesize_group(labels_u8, prm, cfg, level)` directly; helpers `dev_halfwidth_np(cfg)`, `fine_to_train18_table()`, `contrast_image`, `gaussian_operator`, `bias_interp_matrix` (control points at fractions of the physical extent, t = (p + 0.5)(g - 1)/n), `robust_normalise` (stride 4). Trace-once seed TRACE_SEED = 3 (p 0.5, both outcomes within 8 calls) for linear and deform.
